name: ISO/IEC 42001:2023 Artificial Intelligence Management System (AIMS)
disclaimer: Academic reference and mapping crosswalk for ISO/IEC 42001. The platform is an assessment aid and does not provide formal ISO certification or audit attestation.

controls.title: AI Risk Assessment Process
controls.description: Establish, implement, and maintain a documented AI risk assessment process tailored to AI vulnerabilities and threats.
controls.verification_guidance: Check for formal risk scoring, vulnerability scanning logs, and evidence of periodic risk reviews.

controls.title: AI System Life Cycle Development and Testing
controls.description: Security, privacy, and robustness controls are embedded into AI application design, testing, verification, and deployment phases.
controls.verification_guidance: Verify automated CI/CD security scanning, pre-deployment regression tests, and output sanitization test cases.

controls.title: Data for AI Systems & Provenance
controls.description: Ensure data used in training, fine-tuning, or retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) is traceable, authorized, and vetted for quality.
controls.verification_guidance: Audit document ingestion logs, data sensitivity classification, and authorization barriers on vector collections.

controls.title: Third-Party AI Relationship Management
controls.description: Assess and continuously monitor risks arising from third-party foundation models, API providers, and external plugins.
controls.verification_guidance: Verify API key rotation policies, vendor data retention agreements, and fallback redundancy.
